script.when: The boat race (activities/boat-trip/race/): through the rainbow gate in the bay, three laps round a lagoon against the village kids and a cheeky macaque. Sparkle gives the few instructions and the countdown; Mommy and Daddy cheer in their own voices; the kids tease and cheer; the macaque only chatters. She always wins, and the trophy says so.
